name: dft_veh0105_licensed_by_la
title: VEH0105: Licensed vehicles by body type, fuel type and local authority
description: Licensed vehicles at the end of each quarter, by body type, fuel type, keepership (private/company) and upper and lower tier local authority, United Kingdom. Produced by the Department for Transport from DVLA registration data. This is the all-vehicles denominator for VEH0132 (ULEVs).

sources.title: Department for Transport / DVLA — Vehicle licensing statistics

update_cadence: Quarterly (July, September, December) with the full annual release around April/May. Most weekly pipeline runs will therefore detect no change.
caveats: The tidy parquet's count_thousands column is in THOUSANDS of vehicles, exactly as DfT publishes it (the source's constant 'Units: Thousands' column is dropped). Multiply by 1000 for a vehicle count, e.g. 109.441 means 109,441 vehicles.

Vehicles are allocated to a local authority by the registered keeper's postcode, which is not necessarily where the vehicle is located. Company fleets registered to a single head office can distort local figures.
In the tidy parquet, cells DfT suppressed (published as '[x]') become nulls in the count_thousands column.

The tidy parquet keeps the publisher's aggregate rows: body_type='Total', fuel='Total', keepership='Total', and aggregate geographies (United Kingdom, Great Britain, England, regions). Filter these out before summing or you will double-count.

resources.name: raw_ods
resources.description: The unmodified file as published by DfT.

resources.name: tidy_parquet
resources.description: Best-effort long/tidy extraction of the main data sheet: one row per geography x body type x fuel x keepership x quarter. May be absent if the published layout changed; the raw ODS is authoritative.

fields.name: ons_code
fields.description: ONS geography code (e.g. E09000033). Includes aggregate codes such as K02000001 (United Kingdom).

fields.name: ons_geography
fields.description: Geography name as published by DfT (the ODS's hierarchy indentation is trimmed).

fields.name: ons_sort
fields.description: DfT's presentation sort order for geographies.

fields.name: body_type
fields.description: Vehicle body type (e.g. Cars, Motorcycles, Light goods vehicles). Includes the publisher's 'Total' rows — filter before summing.

fields.name: fuel
fields.description: Fuel type. Includes the publisher's 'Total' rows — filter before summing.

fields.name: quarter
fields.description: Publisher quarter label 'YYYY Qn' (e.g. '2025 Q4'); lexicographic order equals temporal order.

fields.name: count_thousands
fields.description: Licensed vehicles at the end of the quarter, in THOUSANDS (e.g. 109.441 = 109,441 vehicles). Null where DfT suppressed the value ('[x]' in the source).
